name: finance
description: Money tracking shaped by your own rules: categories + matching rules + transactions, fed by mail or added manually, LLM-classified with human confirmation.
env_example: # Currency used when one is not stated.
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 008_finance.sql, hot-loads the app).

Everything is defined through the API — start with categories, then rules: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:{{PORT_PLATFORM}}/api/finance/categories -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name": "groceries", "kind": "expense"}'
Rules turn matching mail into pending transactions automatically (the email package feeds them; without it, add transactions manually).
Confirm or fix what the LLM classified: /api/finance/transactions?status=pending
